build_units_encoder: build a UnitsEncoder component that encodes raw unit features into fixed-size embeddings using lookup tables and one-hot vectors
create_transformer_layer: create a Transformer component that applies multi-head attention layers with resblocks to unit embeddings
compute_unit_tags_mask: compute a boolean mask over unit tags using get_unit_tags_mask with modes like NON_EMPTY or TARGETABLE
build_pointer_logits: build a PointerLogits component that produces attention-based logits for selecting units from the units stream
finalize_unit_tags_logits: finalize unit tag selection logits by adding an end-of-selection token and applying selection masks
